title: Headlocks & Heartbreaks
description: Sardina Sardiña and Dwayne “The Puck” Orca in a complicated romance with high stakes both in and outside the ring.
quote: Oh, Dwayne. The only thing I’ve ever loved… is a skull-cracking smackdown!
altHero: Dwayne Orca serenading Sardina Sardiña, who has big puffs of blonde hair
alt1: Sardina lifting Dwayne above her head
alt2: wide shot of Sardina lifting Dwayne in a fighting ring surrounded by an audience
alt3: Sardina about to land on Dwayne
alt4: Dwayne biting Sardina’s arm as a smaller fish throws flower petals in the air
